title: 信息日报 2026-09-05

headline.title: GPT-6 Astra：OpenAI发布新一代智能模型
headline.summary: OpenAI推出新一代旗舰模型GPT-6 Astra，号称最智能且与人类价值观更对齐的模型，在计算机使用、编码、网络安全和科学领域均有突破。目前向有限组织开放，未来数日将面向ChatGPT Plus、Pro、Business和企业用户及API和AWS提供。
headline.title_en: GPT-6 Astra: A new generation of intelligence
headline.summary_en: OpenAI introduced GPT-6 Astra, its most intelligent and aligned model to date, with state-of-the-art capabilities across computer use, coding, cybersecurity, and science. It is now rolling out to a limited set of organizations and will become available to ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise users, as well as through the OpenAI API and AWS.
headline.original_title: GPT-6 Astra: A new generation of intelligence
headline.reason: 作为OpenAI新一代旗舰模型的正式发布，这是当日AI领域最核心的技术与产业事件，后续多家平台快速集成，深刻影响开发者生态与前沿研究。
headline.reason_en: As the official launch of OpenAI's next-generation flagship model, this is the most significant technology and industry event today, with rapid integrations across platforms and deep implications for developer ecosystems and frontier research.
